BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: III
BRANCH: BIOTECHNOLOGY   SESSION : MO/2018

SUBJECT : BT3027 BIOMOLECULES & BIOENERGETICS

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q1 (a) Draw the biochemical structure of DNA? [2]
 (b) What are the different biochemical constituents involved in making a polynucleotide? Give
suitable representation.
[3]

Q2 (a) What do you mean by the term "Hyperchromic Effect"? [2]
 (b) Give the salient features of Watson & Crick model of DNA with proper diagram? [3]

Q3 (a) Explain the term "Zwitterion" with respect to amino acid? [2]
 (b) How are amino acids classified? Explain with suitable examples. [3]

Q4 (a) How is a di-peptide formed? Give the reaction sequence? [2]
 (b) What are the different structural conformations attained by proteins? Give suitable
examples with structures?
[3]

Q5 (a) What are polysaccharides? [2]
 (b) What are carbohydrates? With the help of structures show the formation of D-maltose and
D-lactose?
[3]

Q6 (a) What are "reducing sugar"? Give suitable explanation with example? [2]
 (b) How are carbohydrates classified? Give examples of each? [3]
